intent: Carry the verified inspection state into a responsibility dispute, then show how the chosen reporting basis is tested when additional evidence returns.

stages.purpose: separate verified facts from competing explanations under a 15-minute reporting deadline
test the first report basis against later timestamps, call records, photos, and sequence evidence

presentation_rules: Never label one speaker as the liar; show that statements can differ because people observed different times and roles.
Distinguish a verified field state from an explanation of why that state occurred.
When report_result is written, update the same 11:31 panel from verification question to evidence verdict.
